name: Endeavour (STS-89)
about: Endeavour (STS-89) (1998-003A), a crewed vehicle (OV-105), launched 1998 Jan 23. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1998 Jan 25), held fixed
docked to A05709; GCAT's later phases (auxiliary catalogues) are not read yet
